chain.text: The estate farms 18 hectares. 11 hectares are Cabernet Franc and 7 are Chenin Blanc. Soils are clay and flint. Production averages 62,000 bottles a year. The 2024 harvest yielded 48,000 bottles. May hail destroyed about a fifth of the crop on the western plots. Certification is organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion started in 2023. It requires three consecutive compliant years. The earliest certification date is 2026. Export is 41 percent of sales. Main export markets are Belgium and Japan. The Japanese importer requires sulphites below 60 milligrams per litre. In 2022 a tank 4 controller drifted 3 degrees for two days. That batch lost its aromatic profile. It was sold in bulk at an 11,000 euro loss. Controllers are now calibrated before each harvest. Tank 4 carries a second probe. In 2023 a label error sent 900 bottles with the wrong vintage. All were recalled. Label proofs now require
